text:
Ava (PM): quick heads-up — I posted a PRD draft in the doc for the new rollout framework targeting customer-driven pinning and small-batch experiments. please review acceptance criteria & edge cases before Thurs. https://redwood.internal/notes/rollout-framework-draft
Sam (Eng Lead): skimmed. high-level looks fine. need clarity on capacity isolation when a tenant pins a heavy model — do we autoscale or evict?
Ava (PM): goal is predictable latency for pinned tenants. proposal: reserved slots + burst pool. acceptance: pinned tenants see <=150ms p50 on text-gen at 1kqps baseline.
Priya (Research): add an eval pass for hallucination/regression on each candidate model. we should automatically run the prompt-set if we do A/B.
Diego (PMM): customers that asked for pinning want SLA language and a simple opt-in flow. recommend a checkbox in console + email confirmation. also we should surface cost delta in UX. :money_with_wings:
Marta (SRE): the rollback criteria needs to be explicit. suggest: (1) error rate >1% sustained for 5m, (2) p99 latency > 1.5x baseline for 3m, (3) quality regression > 5% on golden prompts. auto-fallback to previous variant.
Ava (PM): love those. I'll add thresholds to PRD. also adding a canary plan: 1% -> 10% -> 50% -> 100% over 2h windows with manual holdpoints.
Sam (Eng Lead): technical notes: we need a pinning token mapping in the routing layer and enforcement at admission time. proto config: ```
rollout: {
  variant: "v2-quant",
  staged: [1,10,50,100],
  hold_minutes: 120,
  fallback: "v1"
}
```
Priya (Research): edge cases to list in PRD: (a) tenant requests pin to a model not CPU-quantized and capacity unavailable, (b) concurrent pins causing oversubscription, (c) pinned tenant is on dedicated but model not supported. specify expected behavior for each.
Jules (Legal): customers asking for dedicated pinned capacity may need data processing addendum updates. i'll draft a short paragraph about responsibilities and data flow for pinned models.
Ava (PM): acceptance criteria (draft): ["PRD reviewed by eng/research/legal/PMM","Automated eval passes for each rollout candidate","Canary plan defined with holdpoints","Rollback triggers implemented and tested","Console opt-in + cost delta surfaced"]
Sam (Eng Lead): dev tasks I need in sprint: routing + token map (3d), admission control with quota check (2d), canary rollout orchestration (4d). will estimate with @eng-team tomorrow.
Marta (SRE): testing plan: run synthetic traffic + golden prompts in staging, validate p50/p99, run failure injection for fallback path. schedule a game-day after first rollout.
Diego (PMM): i'll prepare customer comms: release notes + opt-in guide. want a brief FAQ for cost and SLA questions.
Ava (PM): next steps — can everyone add short comments to the PRD doc by EOD Wed. if no blockers, we'll schedule a 30m sync Fri to lock rollout cadence. tagging @Sam @Marta @Priya @Diego @Jules. :spiral_calendar:
deploy-bot: Canary job created for rollout-sim v2 at 1798124000 (staging).
Sam (Eng Lead): noted; I'll watch metrics and post updates in this thread during the sync.
Ava (PM): thanks — really looking for any missing edge cases, especially billing or security interactions.
Priya (Research): one more edge-case: A/B overlap where user sessions cross variant boundaries — recommend session affinity by user-id for 24h.
Marta (SRE): acked session affinity; also add throttling for burst pool so other tenants unaffected.
Ava (PM): perfect. will iterate PRD and ping again. :thumbsup:
